note: TWV codes: streaming labels often capitalise the key letter (a minor work is tagged 'D9' or 'E9'), so every recording was matched on movement titles as well; TWV 42:D10 and 43:D5 have no usable recording and TWV 42:c8 only one movement of one. TWV 42:e9 may not be a string work (Darmstadt MS: flute, oboe). TWV 43:A4, C1, D4, F1, G5 are in the 'Quatrieme livre de quatuors' print (Paris, Le Clerc/Boivin, dated ca. 1752 by IMSLP; Dresden MS copies are 1710-35), first-edition scoring flute, violin, viola, bc. Not changed but worth a look: the set 'Trietti metodichi e scherzi' (sources spell 'methodichi'; 100585 outside this chunk shares it) and the Trietti/Scherzi print names flutes before violins (other flute-or-violin prints in the catalogue list the flutes first); TWV 42:A2, c1, D4, e1 (and G3, d2) are nos. 3, 2, 6, 5 of '6 Trio a Violini e Basso' per the TWV catalogue, entries have no set; c1 and e1 give flute+violin, A2 and D4 two violins with a flute alternative (same possibilities). Sources: IMSLP pages via api.php, the TWV catalogue at musiqueorguequebec.ca (telgp42/43/44.html), Deezer album track lists, MusicBrainz, RISM Darmstadt records; no Apple lookups were needed.
